audit_target: F5 Compact Flume Macro 057 Spatial Failure Diagnosis

defect_area_1_bed_hollow_shell.finding: Continuous bed defined as closed 52-facet polyhedron of volume 0.4162 m^3. GenCase <drawtriangles> and <drawfilestl> without autofill='true' only rasterize 2D surface facets. Theoretical solid fill requires 52,023 particles (coarse) and 213,089 particles (medium); actual generated particles are 13,556 (coarse) and 40,561 (medium). The particle counts scale precisely as O(dp^-2) with surface area 5.94 m^2. The continuous bed is completely hollow inside, forming a 1-particle-thick skin over an empty void up to 60 cm high.

defect_area_2_floor_and_sidewall.finding: tank_floor uses <boxfill>bottom</boxfill> at z=-0.15 m, leaving a 15 cm empty vertical gap under the upstream fluid basin (z in [0.0, 0.40] m). Sidewalls have width 0.030 m, which is insufficient to accommodate 3 layers (vdp='0,1,2') at dp=0.020 m (requires 0.060 m), causing lateral boundary layer truncation in coarse resolution.

defect_area_3_support_and_rhopgradient.finding: DualSPHysics Dynamic Boundary Condition (DBC) requires boundary thickness >= 2h (~3.46 dp) for kernel completeness. Single-layer bed provides <35% kernel support. rhopgradient='2' initializes bottom fluid particles at hydrostatic pressure ~3924 Pa, while boundary particles are initialized at reference density pb=0. Under gravity, fluid sags into the hollow bed. SPH boundary penetration depth scales directly with dp, creating a systematic, resolution-dependent fluid column subsidence that accounts for the uniform ~0.17 m SWL discrepancy across all flat-basin gauges.

defect_area_4_gauge_selection_and_dry_cl.finding: In JGaugeSwl::CalculeCpuT, when no fluid is detected (mpre == 0), the measured SWL is clamped to Point0.z = z_bed. In Runup, WG4 (x=3.20 m, still depth 0.064 m = 3.2 dp in coarse) suffered severe resolution dropout: coarse was dry for 782/800 frames (97.75%) while medium was wet for 800/800 frames. In Weir, WG4 is situated on the upstream face of the weir structure (x=3.20 m) and was 100% dry (800/800 frames) in both resolutions. Crest is sub-aerial (z=0.448 m > SWL 0.400 m) and was 100% dry in both mechanisms.

cause_1_hollow_bed.title: Native GenCase STL Autofill
cause_1_hollow_bed.mechanism: Add autofill='true' to <drawfilestl file='assets/f5_compact_continuous_bed_profile.stl' autofill='true' /> and remove redundant initial <drawtriangles>.
cause_1_hollow_bed.pros: Preserves exact 52-facet STL profile while producing complete solid boundary fill.

cause_1_hollow_bed.title: Structured Multi-Layer Extrusion
cause_1_hollow_bed.mechanism: Use GenCase advanced depth extrusion <drawfilestl file='...' advanced='true'><depth depthmin='0.08' /></drawfilestl> to generate guaranteed >=3-layer boundary shell without deep interior void overhead.
cause_1_hollow_bed.pros: Provides 100% kernel support with bounded boundary particle count.

cause_2_floor_and_sidewall.title: Floor Datum Realignment
cause_2_floor_and_sidewall.mechanism: Align tank_floor directly beneath the flat basin at datum z=0.00 m with solid fill and 3 layers, eliminating the 15 cm void.
cause_2_floor_and_sidewall.pros: Ensures contiguous, solid substrate under upstream fluid.

cause_2_floor_and_sidewall.title: Sidewall Width Expansion
cause_2_floor_and_sidewall.mechanism: Increase sidewall box width to 0.060 m (>=3 dp_coarse), ensuring 3 boundary layers instantiate without truncation at coarse resolution.
cause_2_floor_and_sidewall.pros: Restores lateral kernel completeness across all commensurate resolutions.

cause_3_shoreline_gauges.title: Shoreline Gauge Realignment
cause_3_shoreline_gauges.mechanism: Reposition WG4 from x=3.20 m upstream to x=2.90 m (depth 0.148 m = 7.4 dp_coarse), and reposition Weir WG4 to downstream receiving basin.
cause_3_shoreline_gauges.pros: Eliminates false resolution dropout and weir solid obstruction.

cause_3_shoreline_gauges.title: Segmented Evaluation Contract
cause_3_shoreline_gauges.mechanism: Retain native dry codes but report wet_only_relative_eta_rmse and resolution_dropout_fraction separately.
cause_3_shoreline_gauges.pros: Decouples physical free-surface convergence from dry-clamping artifacts.
